reviewNotes: Twenty-five Krobus, cinema, cursed-doll, and soundtrack-title strings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover exact dialogue controls and emotions, canonical pendant and location names, housemate terminology, gender-neutral guest wording, established film and Junimo Kart titles, music-title voice, punctuation, and character tone; both found no remaining objective issue.

Krobus_Engaged.source: A Void Ghost pendant! How did you...?$3#$b#Oh, wow.$7#$b#@... yes, I'll come live with you, if you like. But we have to keep it secret from everyone.#$b#I'll be at your house in a few days... okay?$h
Krobus_Engaged.translation: Un Pandantiv al Fantomei Vidului! Cum ai...?$3#$b#Ah, uau.$7#$b#@... da, voi veni să locuiesc cu tine, dacă vrei. Dar trebuie să păstrăm secretul față de toată lumea.#$b#Voi ajunge la tine acasă în câteva zile... bine?$h

Krobus_AfterWedding.source: Good morning, @... I snuck in during the night.$l#$b#It'll take me a while to get used to this new life... This is very different from the sewers...
Krobus_AfterWedding.translation: Bună dimineața, @... M-am strecurat înăuntru în timpul nopții.$l#$b#Îmi va lua ceva timp să mă obișnuiesc cu viața aceasta nouă... Este foarte diferită de canalizare...

TriedToMarryButKrobus.source: You can't propose to someone while living with a housemate.
TriedToMarryButKrobus.translation: Nu poți cere mâna cuiva cât timp locuiești cu un coleg de casă.

KrobusShopGone.source: I'm away. Please leave your payment in the box. -Krobus
KrobusShopGone.translation: Sunt plecat. Te rog să lași plata în cutie. -Krobus

MovieTheaterBoxOffice.source: Get your movie tickets right here! Give one to a friend to invite them to the show!
MovieTheaterBoxOffice.translation: Bilete la film chiar aici! Dăruiește unul unei persoane apropiate ca s-o inviți la film!

MovieTheaterConcessions0.source: Hello! How may I help you?
MovieTheaterConcessions0.translation: Bună! Cu ce te pot ajuta?

MovieTheaterConcessions1.source: Need a snack for the movie?
MovieTheaterConcessions1.translation: Ai nevoie de o gustare pentru film?

MovieTheaterConcessions2.source: Your guest looks hungry... I'm sure I have something they'll love!
MovieTheaterConcessions2.translation: Pare că persoanei invitate îi este foame... Cu siguranță am ceva care îi va plăcea!

MovieTheaterConcessions3.source: It's an upgrade from my last job...
MovieTheaterConcessions3.translation: Este un pas înainte față de ultima mea slujbă...

MovieTheaterConcessions4.source: Your guest looks like they could use a snack. What'll it be?
MovieTheaterConcessions4.translation: Se pare că persoanei invitate i-ar prinde bine o gustare. Ce să fie?

Cursed_Doll.source: You've brought this upon yourself... now I'm free... Hee hee hee!
Cursed_Doll.translation: Ți-ai făcut-o cu mâna ta... acum am scăpat... Hi, hi, hi!
